_doc: Lean: a hold's loyalty shares (sum 100). Thresholds, the player's levers and conquest. See docs/design/07-economy.md and 10-warlords-and-politics.md.

drift._doc: Lean moves toward a faction by taking points from independent first, then from the faction with the largest share.
drift._doc_home_rule: Every month each hold that isn't a living faction's seat moves this many points from its largest faction share back to independent, unless that share is at least home_rule_exempt_at_share (a hold that's firmly held, such as a fresh conquest at 60, stays held). People prefer to run their own lives; loose influence has to be kept up.
